Roof Measurement & Cost Estimator

Get a rough estimate for repair or full replacement. Measure your roof with free Google Earth tools, then enter the numbers below.

How to measure your roof with Google Earth (free):
1. Download Google Earth Pro (free desktop app) or use Google Earth Web.
2. Search your address, switch to top-down view, and zoom in on the roof.
3. Use the Ruler / Measure tool → Polygon. Click around the roof edges to get the horizontal square footage.
4. Note the area (sq ft). For pitched roofs, multiply by ~1.1–1.2 for a closer surface estimate. Then enter it below.

Estimates are approximate ranges based on 2026 North Alabama averages. Actual price depends on pitch, layers, decking condition, and accessibility. Call for a free on-site estimate.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you offer free estimates?

Yes. We provide free on-site estimates for both repairs and full replacements across North Alabama.

How long does a roof last?

Architectural asphalt shingles typically last 25–30 years in our climate when properly installed and maintained.

Do you handle insurance claims?

We can inspect storm damage, document findings, and work with your insurance company when needed.

What areas do you serve?

Based in Guntersville, we serve Guntersville, Albertville, Arab, Scottsboro, Huntsville, Decatur, Athens, Gadsden, and surrounding North Alabama communities.
